TRL Mode v5.0 - Features Overview
​Cyberpunk Loading Screen: A 6-second dynamic startup sequence with real-time progress tracking and shifting status text.
​OLED & Neon UI: Dark-themed responsive interface designed for Delta with glowing cyan accents and draggable controls.
​Universal Player Teleport: Live-updating player list allowing instant one-click teleportation to any user.
​ESP Highlights: Player visual tracking through walls using neon highlights.
​Fly Mode: Full free-flight movement control using camera direction.
​Infinite Jump: Unlimited mid-air jumping capabilities.
​Speed Hack: Adjustable walk speed boost for fast navigation.
​SpinBot: Crazy 360-degree continuous character rotation.
​Platform Spawn: Instant creation of temporary solid platforms beneath your feet.
​FOV Extender: Zoom out camera capability for a wider field of view.
​Noclip: Smooth wall-walking across any map.
​Invisible Mode: Complete avatar ghost transparency.
​Body Scaling & Limbs: Tools for giant avatar scaling and limb visibility toggles.
​Instant Sit: Immediate character sitting action anywhere.
​Custom Emotes: Classic animations and the unique "Head Toss" emote.
​Changelog Logbook: Complete built-in update history tracking from v1.0 to v5.0.

local function CreateTabButton(name, order, targetPage)
    local tabBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", TabBar)
    tabBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 65, 1, 0)

    tabBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    tabBtn.Text = name
    tabBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 170)
    tabBtn.TextSize = 11
    tabBtn.LayoutOrder = order
    Instance.new("UICorner", tabBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    
    tabBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        PagePlayers.Visible = false
        PageMovement.Visible = false
        PageBody.Visible = false
        PageEmotes.Visible = false
        PageChangelog.Visible = false
        targetPage.Visible = true
        
        for _, child in ipairs(TabBar:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("TextButton") then
                child.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 30)
                child.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 170)
            end
        end
        tabBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 140)
        tabBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    end)
    return tabBtn
end

Tab1.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 140)

-- ==================== 1. PLAYERS TAB (TP + ESP #9) ====================
local PlayersLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout", PagePlayers)
PlayersLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
PlayersLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)

local espActive = false
local espHighlights = {}

local function ToggleESP(btn)
    espActive = not espActive
    if espActive then
        btn.Text = "👁️ ESP Highlights: [ON]"
        btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 120)
        -- Create ESP
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= Player and p.Character then
                local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
                hl.Adornee = p.Character
                hl.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 200)
                hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                hl.Parent = p.Character
                espHighlights[p] = hl
            end
        end
    else
        btn.Text = "👁️ ESP Highlights: [OFF]"
        btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 0)
        for _, hl in pairs(espHighlights) do
            hl:Destroy()
        end
        espHighlights = {}
    end
end

local espBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", PagePlayers)
espBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 36)
espBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 25, 35)
espBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
espBtn.Text = "👁️ ESP Highlights: [OFF]"
espBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 0)
espBtn.TextSize = 12
Instance.new("UICorner", espBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
espBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() ToggleESP(espBtn) end)

local function UpdatePlayerList()
    for _, child in ipairs(PagePlayers:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("TextButton") and child ~= espBtn then child:Destroy() end
    end
    local count = 1
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= Player then
            count = count + 1
            local pBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", PagePlayers)
            pBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 36)
            pBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 26)
            pBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
            pBtn.Text = " ➔ TP to: " .. plr.Name
            pBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 255, 250)
            pBtn.TextSize = 12
            pBtn.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
            Instance.new("UICorner", pBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
            
            pBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                local tChar, mChar = plr.Character, Player.Character
                if tChar and tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and mChar and mChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                    mChar.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = tChar.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
                end
            end)
        end
    end
    PagePlayers.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, count * 42)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p)
    UpdatePlayerList()
    p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
        if espActive then
            task.wait(1)
            local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
            hl.Adornee = char
            hl.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 200)
            hl.Parent = char
            espHighlights[p] = hl
        end
    end)
end)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(UpdatePlayerList)
UpdatePlayerList()

    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 26)
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    btn.Text = name
    btn.TextColor3 = color
    btn.TextSize = 12
    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", btn)
    stroke.Color = color
    stroke.Transparency = 0.5
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() callback(btn) end)
    return btn
end

-- #1 Fly Mode
local flying = false
local flyConnection
CreateMoveBtn("🕊️ Fly Mode (Flight)", Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 200), function(btn)
    flying = not flying
    local char = Player.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
    if flying then
        btn.Text = "🕊️ Fly Mode: [ON]"
        btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 120)
        flyConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            local hrp = char.HumanoidRootPart
            hrp.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
                hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame + (Camera.CFrame.LookVector * 1.5)
            end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
                hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame - (Camera.CFrame.LookVector * 1.5)
            end
        end)
    else
        btn.Text = "🕊️ Fly Mode (Flight)"
        btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 200)
        if flyConnection then flyConnection:Disconnect() end
    end
end)

-- #2 Infinite Jump

UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
    if infJumpActive then
        local char = Player.Character
        if char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
            char.Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
        end
    end
end)

        char.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = speedActive and 45 or 16

    spinning = not spinning
    btn.Text = spinning and "🌀 SpinBot: [ON]" or "🌀 SpinBot (360 Spin)"

    local char = Player.Character

        local p = Instance.new("Part", Workspace)

CreateMoveBtn("🔭 FOV Extender (Zoom Out)", Color3.fromRGB(0, 220, 255), function(btn)

    noclipActive = not noclipActive

        btn.Text = "🧱 Noclip (Walk Through Walls)"
        btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 0)
    end

-- #5 Invisible Mode

    invisible = not invisible
    local char = Player.Character
    if char then
        local t = invisible and 1 or 0
        for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") or part.Name == "Head" then
                part.Transparency = t

        end

    btn.Text = invisible and "👻 Invisible Mode: [ON]" or "👻 Invisible Mode (Ghost)"

-- Limbs Hide

CreateBodyBtn("👤 Toggle Limbs Transparency", Color3.fromRGB(200, 100, 255), function()

    for _, part in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do

            part.Transparency = t
        end

-- Giant Size
CreateBodyBtn("🗿 Giant Avatar Scale", Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 200), function()
    local char = Player.Character
    if char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        pcall(function()
            char.Head.Size = Vector3.new(3, 3, 3)
            char.Humanoid.BodyDepthScale.Value = 2
            char.Humanoid.BodyHeightScale.Value = 2
            char.Humanoid.BodyWidthScale.Value = 2
            char.Humanoid.HeadScale.Value = 2
        end)
    end
end)

-- #10 Instant Sit
CreateBodyBtn("🪑 Instant Sit Down", Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 150), function()
    local char = Player.Character
    if char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
        char.Humanoid.Sit = true
    end

PageBody.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 220)

local function StopAllEmotes()
    local char = Player.Character
    if char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        for _, track in ipairs(char.Humanoid:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
            track:Stop()
        end
    end
end

local function PlayEmote(animId)
    StopAllEmotes()
    local char = Player.Character
    if char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
        anim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. animId
        char.Humanoid:LoadAnimation(anim):Play()
    end
end

}

    if lastInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        envState.Mode = "Touch"
    elseif lastInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1 or string.find(lastInputType.Name, "Gamepad") then
        envState.Mode = "Gamepad"
    elseif string.find(lastInputType.Name, "Mouse") then
        envState.Mode = "Mouse"
    end
end)

-- 2. 动态环境修复补丁（移动端与 PC 统一保持阴影开启与原版亮度 4）
local function applyEnvironmentPatch(light)
    envState.IsMobile = UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.MouseEnabled
    envState.Mode = envState.IsMobile and "Touch" or "Mouse"
    
    if light then
        light.Shadows = true -- 全平台强制开启实时影子
        light.Brightness = 4 -- 保持原版亮度（4 级）
    end
end
-- ==================================================================

local success, objects = pcall(function()
    return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. gearId)
end)

if success and objects and #objects > 0 then
    local tool = objects[1]
    if not tool:IsA("Tool") then tool = tool:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") end

    if tool then
        local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") or tool:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
        local sound = tool:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Sound", true)
        
        -- 初始化光效挂载轴
        local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
        attachment.Name = "LightPivot"
        attachment.Parent = handle
        
        local light = Instance.new("SpotLight")
        light.Parent = attachment
        light.Range = 60
        light.Angle = 50
        light.Enabled = false
        
        -- 应用全平台阴影与亮度设定
        applyEnvironmentPatch(light)
        
        local isOn = false
        local connection = nil

        -- 清理逻辑（防止重置角色时内存泄漏）
        local function cleanup()
            isOn = false
            light.Enabled = false
            if connection then
                connection:Disconnect()
                connection = nil
            end
        end

        -- 交互逻辑
        tool.Activated:Connect(function()
            isOn = not isOn
            light.Enabled = isOn
            
            if sound then sound:Play() end
            
            if isOn then
                connection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
                    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
                    if handle and character and tool.Parent == character then
                        
                        if envState.Mode == "Touch" then
                            -- 触屏模式：锁定角色正前方（影子全开）

	end)
